name: Defusing Ultimata (The Hypothetical Reframe)
stage: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith
scenario: An opposing party delivers an aggressive ultimatum: "Agree to these pricing terms by noon or our firm walks away permanently."
script: "Hypothetically speaking, if we were able to address your cash-flow timing concerns through an adjusted payment schedule, what would that mean for our ongoing collaboration?"
defense: This is not hypothetical: the board has fixed this expenditure cap; institutional authority does not extend beyond it.
originFull: Cognitive Reframing and Face-Saving Protocols prove that directly challenging an ultimatum forces the counterparty into an ego trap where backing down is perceived as public defeat.
defenseFull: When a counterparty attempts to reframe an authentic operational boundary: "This is not a hypothetical posture or a tactical opening. Our executive board has formally established this expenditure cap; we do not have institutional authority to negotiate beyond it."
